<style data-ws-von="assets/uh.css">/* Uncle Hung · Designstudie Tasty Studios, 11.11.2026.
   Form vom Haus (Salbei und Creme der heutigen Seite, Schale im U, Jade der Schalen), Niveau von Tasty (Tiefe, Dichte, Hochschweben).
   Bewegung nur über transform und opacity, nativer Scroll. Drehbuch: ../CHARAKTER.md */
@font-face{font-family:"Fraunces";src:url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/unclehung/grundlage/assets/schrift/fraunces-soft.woff2) format("woff2");font-weight:100 900;font-display:block}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Sans";src:url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/unclehung/grundlage/assets/schrift/InstrumentSans-normal-400_600.woff2) format("woff2");font-weight:400 700;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"DM Mono";src:url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/unclehung/grundlage/assets/schrift/DMMono-normal-400.woff2) format("woff2");font-weight:400;font-display:swap}

:root{
  --salbei:#4D5C4E; --tief:#2B342D; --tief2:#344036; --tief3:#3E4B40;
  --creme:#EBE1D4; --papier:#F7EFE3; --papier2:#F1E7D8; --sand:#DCCFBC;
  --gold:#BF982E; --gold-h:#D9BC6B; --gold-l:rgba(217,188,107,.28); --gold-ll:rgba(217,188,107,.14);
  --jade:#86AE98; --jade-t:#5E8A73;
  --tinte:#1F2620; --tinte2:rgba(31,38,32,.74); --tinte3:rgba(31,38,32,.52);
  --hell:#F4ECE0; --hell2:rgba(244,236,224,.76); --hell3:rgba(244,236,224,.54);
  --titel:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif; --lauf:"Instrument Sans","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif; --mono:"DM Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;
  --k:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); --kk:cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1);
  --ecke:clamp(22px,2.6vw,40px);
  --rand:clamp(20px,4.6vw,76px);
  --breit:min(1440px, calc(100vw - 2*var(--rand)));
  --schatten:0 34px 70px -30px rgba(18,24,19,.55),0 12px 26px -14px rgba(18,24,19,.35);
  --schatten-d:0 34px 80px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 12px 28px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{background:var(--tief);color:var(--tinte);font:400 18px/1.64 var(--lauf);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;scroll-behavior:auto}
body{margin:0;overflow-x:clip;background:transparent}   /* durchsichtig, damit die Fensterbilder (z-index −1) nicht vom Grund des body verdeckt werden */
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
p,h1,h2,h3,h4,figure,ul,ol{margin:0;padding:0}
ul{list-style:none}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-weight:400}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
::selection{background:var(--gold-h);color:var(--tinte)}
.vh{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}

/* Erster Blick komplett: die Seite zeigt sich erst, wenn die Bilder im ersten Bild geladen sind (Rückfall ohne Skript: sofort) */
html.js body{opacity:0} html.js.offen body{opacity:1}
@media (scripting:none){html.js body{opacity:1}}

/* ---------- Schrift */
.titel{font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:540;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 0,"opsz" 120;letter-spacing:-.012em;line-height:1.04}
.t-riese{font-size:clamp(58px,9.4vw,152px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.022em}
.t-kap{font-size:clamp(40px,5.4vw,84px);line-height:1.02}
.t-mittel{font-size:clamp(30px,3.2vw,48px);line-height:1.08}
.t-klein{font-size:clamp(23px,2vw,30px);line-height:1.16}
.titel em{font-style:normal;color:var(--jade-t)}
.dunkel .titel em,.d .titel em{color:var(--gold-h)}
.mono{font:400 13px/1.2 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.text{color:var(--tinte2);max-width:58ch}
.text + .text{margin-top:1em}
.gross{font-size:clamp(19px,1.45vw,22px);line-height:1.6}
.dunkel{background:var(--tief);color:var(--hell)}
.dunkel .text{color:var(--hell2)}
.zitat{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 40;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(21px,1.8vw,27px);line-height:1.4}

/* ---------- Knöpfe: Pille mit rundem Pfeil-Knauf, Tiefe in drei Stufen */
.knopf{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:56px;padding:0 7px 0 28px;border-radius:999px;border:0;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;
  font:400 13px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--hell);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5A6B5B 0%,var(--salbei) 52%,#435244 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2),inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 18px 34px -16px rgba(20,28,22,.7);
  transition:transform 1.6s var(--kk),box-shadow 1.6s var(--kk);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.knopf i{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F8F1E6,#E3D7C5);color:var(--tief);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff,0 6px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.knopf i svg{width:17px;height:17px;transition:transform 1.4s var(--kk)}
.knopf::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.22) 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(-120%)}
.knopf:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)} .knopf:hover i svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.knopf:hover::after{transform:translateX(120%);transition:transform 1.3s var(--k)}
.knopf:active{transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985);transition-duration:.2s}
.knopf.hellk{color:var(--tinte);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FBF6EE 0%,#EFE5D7 55%,#E3D6C4 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff,inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(120,100,70,.18),0 18px 34px -16px rgba(40,34,24,.45)}
.knopf.hellk i{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#56685A,var(--tief2));color:var(--hell);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2),0 6px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.knopf.gold{color:var(--tinte);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#E6CC85 0%,#CBA749 55%,#B48F33 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55),inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(90,64,10,.3),0 18px 34px -16px rgba(80,60,10,.6)}
.knopf.gold i{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3F4D41,var(--tief));color:var(--gold-h)}
.knopf.klein{height:46px;padding-left:20px;gap:14px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em} .knopf.klein i{width:34px;height:34px} .knopf.klein i svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.knoepfe{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center}

/* ---------- Bewegung: Hochschweben (deckend), Fläche, Staffel, Schlitz, Zoom */
.auf .sw,.sw.auf{transform:translateY(90px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--k);transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0)*.09s)}
.da .sw,.sw.da{transform:none}
.auf .fl{transform:translateY(70px) scale(.97);transition:transform 1.5s var(--k)}
.da .fl{transform:none}
.auf .staffel>*{transform:translateY(46px);opacity:0;transition:transform 1.3s var(--k),opacity 1s var(--k);transition-delay:calc(var(--n,0)*.11s)}
.da .staffel>*{transform:none;opacity:1}
.auf .staffel>.foto,.auf .staffel>.menu,.auf .staffel>.zt{opacity:1;transform:translateY(80px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--k);transition-delay:calc(var(--n,0)*.1s)}   /* Fotos und Karten deckend, nur Weg */
.da .staffel>.foto,.da .staffel>.menu,.da .staffel>.zt{transform:none}
.auf .tx{transform:translateY(30px);opacity:0;transition:transform 1.6s var(--k),opacity 1.4s var(--k);transition-delay:calc(.12s + var(--i,0)*.1s)}
.da .tx{transform:none;opacity:1}
.zl .z{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:.04em .1em .12em;margin:-.04em -.1em -.12em}
.zl .z>span{display:block;transform:translateY(112%);transition:transform 1.35s var(--k);transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0)*.095s)}
.da .zl .z>span,.zl.da .z>span{transform:none}
.foto{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--tief2) center/cover no-repeat;background-image:var(--lq);border-radius:22px}
.foto img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.14);transition:transform 2.7s var(--k)}
.da .foto img,.foto.da img{transform:scale(1)}
.foto.leise:hover img{transform:scale(1.02);transition-duration:2.6s}
img.lad{opacity:0} img.lad.geladen{opacity:1} img.lad.blende{transition:opacity .5s ease,transform 2.7s var(--k)}
.ruhig .sw,.ruhig .fl,.ruhig .staffel>*,.ruhig .tx,.ruhig .zl .z>span,.ruhig .foto img{transform:none!important;opacity:1!important;transition:none!important}
@media (min-width:0){.sw,.fl,.staffel>*,.tx,.zl .z>span,.foto img{transform:none!important;opacity:1!important;transition:none!important}}

/* ---------- Leiste: schmale Insel in der Mitte, zwei Eck-Knöpfe */
.leiste{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:16px;z-index:60;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0 var(--rand);pointer-events:none;transition:transform 1s var(--k)}
.leiste.weg{transform:translateY(-140%)}
.leiste>*{pointer-events:auto}
.insel{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;height:58px;padding:0 26px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(62,75,64,.97),rgba(43,52,45,.97));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12),inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gold-ll),0 20px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.insel .marke{display:block;height:34px;color:var(--hell)} .insel .marke svg{height:100%;width:auto;display:block}
.insel nav{display:flex;gap:20px}
.insel nav a{position:relative;font:400 13px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--hell2);padding:8px 0;transition:color .5s}
.insel nav a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:2px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-h);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .8s var(--k)}
.insel nav a:hover,.insel nav a.aktiv{color:var(--hell)} .insel nav a:hover::after,.insel nav a.aktiv::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.ecke{min-width:0}
.menue-t{display:none}
.mvoll{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:70;background:var(--tief);color:var(--hell);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:90px var(--rand) 40px;transform:translateY(-102%);transition:transform .9s var(--k);visibility:hidden}
.mvoll.auf-m{transform:none;visibility:visible}
.mvoll a{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 100;font-weight:520;font-size:clamp(34px,9vw,56px);line-height:1.18;display:block}
.mvoll .zu{position:absolute;top:22px;right:var(--rand);width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--tief3);color:var(--hell);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.mvoll .mono{color:var(--gold-h);margin-top:34px;display:block}

/* ---------- Abschnitte: runde Ecken, legen sich über den vorigen */
.kap{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:clamp(64px,6.4vw,108px) 0;background:var(--papier);border-radius:var(--ecke) var(--ecke) 0 0;margin-top:calc(-1*var(--ecke))}
.kap.d{background:var(--tief);color:var(--hell)} .kap.d .text{color:var(--hell2)}
.kap.c{background:var(--creme)}
.kap.s{background:var(--salbei);color:var(--hell)} .kap.s .text{color:var(--hell2)}
.innen{width:var(--breit);margin:0 auto}
.kk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.9fr);gap:clamp(28px,6vw,110px);align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(44px,5vw,78px)}
.kk .titel .z:last-child>span{color:var(--jade-t)}
.d .kk .titel .z:last-child>span,.s .kk .titel .z:last-child>span{color:var(--gold-h)}
.kk .rechts{padding-bottom:.5em;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.16);padding-bottom:28px}
.d .kk .rechts,.s .kk .rechts{border-color:rgba(244,236,224,.18)}
.kk .rechts .knoepfe{margin-top:26px}

/* ---------- 1 Auftakt */
.auftakt{position:relative;z-index:1;min-height:100vh;min-height:max(100svh,620px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;background:var(--tief);overflow:hidden;color:var(--hell)}
.at-bild{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--tief2) center/cover no-repeat;background-image:var(--lq)}
.at-bild img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 46%;transform:scale(1.1);transition:transform 3.2s var(--k)}
.auftakt.da .at-bild img{transform:scale(1.0)}
.at-hof{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(70% 80% at 14% 64%,rgba(16,21,17,.9) 0%,rgba(16,21,17,.74) 38%,rgba(16,21,17,.32) 64%,rgba(16,21,17,0) 84%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(16,21,17,.62),rgba(16,21,17,0) 46%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(16,21,17,.45),rgba(16,21,17,0) 22%)}
.at-oben{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:3;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:26px var(--rand)}
.at-oben .marke{height:clamp(44px,4.4vw,62px);color:var(--hell)} .at-oben .marke svg{height:100%;width:auto;display:block}
.at-oben nav{display:flex;gap:26px} .at-oben nav a{font:400 13px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--hell);opacity:.88}
.at-inhalt{position:relative;z-index:2;width:var(--breit);margin:0 auto;padding:0 0 clamp(54px,7vh,96px)}
.at-ort{color:var(--gold-h);margin-bottom:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(10,14,11,.85),0 0 4px rgba(10,14,11,.6)} .at-ort i{display:block;width:44px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-h)}
.at-inhalt .titel{max-width:11ch}
.at-satz{margin-top:28px;max-width:46ch;font-size:clamp(19px,1.5vw,22px);line-height:1.58;color:var(--hell)}
.at-inhalt .knoepfe{margin-top:36px}
.at-zeiten{position:absolute;right:var(--rand);bottom:clamp(54px,7vh,96px);z-index:2;text-align:right;color:var(--hell2)}
.at-zeiten b{display:block;font-weight:400;color:var(--hell);font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 40;font-size:24px;margin-top:6px}
.auftakt .zl .z>span{transition-duration:1.5s}
.auftakt .tx{transition-delay:calc(.35s + var(--i,0)*.12s)}

/* ---------- 2 Familie: Bildwand und Zahlen */
.fam{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.04fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(36px,5.5vw,96px);align-items:center}
.fam-text .titel{margin-bottom:30px}
.fam-text .zitat{margin:34px 0 0;padding-left:26px;border-left:2px solid var(--jade);color:var(--tinte)}
.fam-text .zitat small{display:block;margin-top:12px;font:400 13px/1.3 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--tinte3)}
.wand{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:10px;height:clamp(520px,50vw,780px)}
.wand .spalte{display:grid;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;min-height:0}
.wand .foto{border-radius:20px}
#familie .wand .w3 img{filter:grayscale(1)}
.zahlen{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);margin-top:clamp(64px,7vw,110px);border-top:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.16)}
.zahl{padding:34px 28px 0 0}
.zahl + .zahl{padding-left:28px;border-left:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.16)}
.zahl b{display:block;font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:500;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 144;font-size:clamp(64px,7.6vw,124px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--tinte)}
.zahl b small{font-size:.42em;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--jade-t);margin-left:.08em}
.zahl span{display:block;margin-top:14px;color:var(--tinte2);max-width:30ch}

/* ---------- Fenster: Bild und Satz stehen, die Seite zieht darüber */
.fenster{position:relative;z-index:auto;height:min(70vh,680px);margin-top:calc(-1*var(--ecke));background:transparent}
.fenster .fb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;visibility:hidden;background:var(--tief2) center/cover no-repeat;background-image:var(--lq)}
.fenster.an .fb{visibility:visible}
.fenster .fb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.fenster .fb::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(62% 48% at 50% 50%,rgba(14,19,15,.62),rgba(14,19,15,.18) 70%,rgba(14,19,15,0) 90%)}
.fenster .fs{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:50%;z-index:-1;transform:translateY(-50%);visibility:hidden;text-align:center;color:var(--hell);padding:0 var(--rand)}
.fenster.an .fs{visibility:visible}
.fenster .fs .titel{font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,72px);max-width:20ch;margin:0 auto}
.fenster .fs .mono{display:block;margin-top:22px;color:var(--gold-h)}

/* ---------- 4 Mittags: Tageszettel */
.mittag{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(0,1.08fr);gap:clamp(30px,5vw,90px);align-items:stretch}
.mittag .foto{flex:1;min-height:520px;border-radius:24px}
.zettel{position:relative;background:var(--papier);color:var(--tinte);border-radius:26px;padding:clamp(34px,4vw,62px);box-shadow:var(--schatten-d)}
.zettel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:12px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid rgba(191,152,46,.45);pointer-events:none}
.zettel .kopfz{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;padding-bottom:22px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.16)}
.zettel .kopfz .mono{color:var(--gold)}
.zettel ol li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr auto;gap:18px;align-items:baseline;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.12)}
.zettel ol li .nr{font:400 13px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--jade-t)}
.zettel ol li .was{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 36;font-weight:440;font-size:clamp(19px,1.5vw,23px);line-height:1.3}
.zettel ol li .pr{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 36;font-size:22px;white-space:nowrap}
.zettel .dazu{margin-top:26px;display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;color:var(--tinte2)}
.zettel .dazu b{font-weight:400;color:var(--tinte)}
.zettel .bis{flex:none;font:400 13px/1.25 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--tinte);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EBD38F,#D3B25A);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;text-align:center;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5),0 10px 20px -12px rgba(90,64,10,.55)}

/* ---------- 5 Favoriten: die Schalen-Bühne */
.fav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.08fr);gap:clamp(30px,5vw,90px);align-items:stretch}
.fav-rechts{display:flex} .fav-wand{height:auto;min-height:560px;flex:1;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.fav-liste{border-top:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.16)}
.fav-liste button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer;display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto;gap:16px;align-items:baseline;width:100%;padding:17px 18px 17px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.12);transition:background .8s var(--k),padding .8s var(--k)}
.fav-liste .nr{font:400 13px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--tinte3);letter-spacing:.1em}
.fav-liste .nm{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 48;font-weight:480;font-size:clamp(21px,1.8vw,28px);line-height:1.2;color:var(--tinte2);transition:color .6s}
.fav-liste .pr{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 36;font-size:20px;color:var(--tinte3);transition:color .6s}

/* Anfrage: heller Briefbogen vor dem Foto */

.tafel-b{border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3B483D,#2F3A31);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gold-ll),var(--schatten-d);padding:clamp(30px,3.4vw,56px);color:var(--hell);display:flex;flex-direction:column}

.studie{background:#1E2620;color:var(--hell3);font:400 13px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;text-align:center;padding:16px var(--rand)}

/* ---------- Unterseiten */

.legende{margin-top:30px;font:400 13px/1.7 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--tinte3);max-width:110ch}
.saison{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(30px,5vw,90px);align-items:center}

  .raum-zeilen{grid-template-columns:1fr}

  .cat-wand{height:auto;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto} .cat-wand .foto{aspect-ratio:4/5} .cat-wand .c1,.cat-wand .c4{grid-row:auto}
  .felder{grid-template-columns:1fr} .feld.ganz{grid-column:auto}

.kv.hell{background:var(--papier);color:var(--tinte)} .kv.salbei{background:var(--salbei)} .kv.tief{background:var(--tief)} .kv.matcha{background:#5C7653}

.kv-g.rechts55{left:45%} .kv-g.rechts45{left:55%} .kv-g.rechts60{left:40%}
.kv-g.links35{right:65%} .kv-g.links55{right:45%}
.kv-g.fenster-unten{top:46%;left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand)} .kv-g.fenster-unten>.hk{border-radius:var(--ecke) var(--ecke) 0 0}
.kv-g.fenster-rechts{top:122px;bottom:44px;left:54%;right:var(--rand)} .kv-g.fenster-rechts.gross{left:44%} .kv-g.fenster-rechts>.hk{border-radius:28px}
.kv-g.band-mitte{top:47%;bottom:auto;height:38%}
.kv-g.reihe,.kv-g.band{top:auto;bottom:44px;left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand);height:30%} .kv-g.reihe>.hk,.kv-g.band>.hk{border-radius:18px}
.kv-g.band{height:26%}
.kv-g.quadrate{top:auto;bottom:48px;left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand);height:min(46%,calc((100vw - 2 * var(--rand) - 30px) / 4))} .kv-g.quadrate>.hk{border-radius:22px}
.kv-g.unten-hoch{top:auto;bottom:44px;left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand);height:50%} .kv-g.unten-hoch>.hk{border-radius:22px}
.kv-g.rahmen-rechts{top:122px;bottom:44px;left:46%;right:var(--rand);padding:14px;background:#fff;border-radius:30px;box-shadow:var(--schatten)} .kv-g.rahmen-rechts>.hk{border-radius:18px}
.kv-g.unten-rechts{top:auto;left:46%;right:0;bottom:0;height:60%} .kv-g.unten-rechts>.hk{border-radius:var(--ecke) 0 0 0}
.kv-hof{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.kv-hof.links,.kv-hof.bl{background:radial-gradient(72% 82% at 14% 74%,rgba(16,21,17,.9) 0%,rgba(16,21,17,.68) 38%,rgba(16,21,17,.2) 66%,rgba(16,21,17,0) 84%)}
.kv-hof.rechts{background:radial-gradient(72% 82% at 86% 74%,rgba(16,21,17,.9) 0%,rgba(16,21,17,.68) 38%,rgba(16,21,17,.2) 66%,rgba(16,21,17,0) 84%)}
.kv-hof.mitte{background:radial-gradient(60% 56% at 50% 52%,rgba(16,21,17,.84),rgba(16,21,17,.5) 62%,rgba(16,21,17,.2) 100%)}
.kv-hof.oben{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(16,21,17,.88) 0%,rgba(16,21,17,.55) 36%,rgba(16,21,17,0) 64%)}
.kv-hof.unten{background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(16,21,17,.9) 0%,rgba(16,21,17,.6) 38%,rgba(16,21,17,0) 66%)}
.kv-hof.voll{background:rgba(16,21,17,.6)}
.kv-t{position:absolute;z-index:3;max-width:min(720px,52vw)}
.kv-t .titel{max-width:none!important}
.kv-t.tl{left:var(--rand);top:clamp(128px,17vh,170px)}
.kv-t.tr{right:var(--rand);top:clamp(128px,17vh,170px);max-width:min(560px,40vw)}
.kv-t.bl{left:var(--rand);bottom:clamp(48px,7vh,88px)}
.kv-t.br{right:var(--rand);bottom:clamp(48px,7vh,88px);text-align:right;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end}
.kv-t.br .at-ort{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.kv-t.bc{left:50%;bottom:clamp(48px,7vh,88px);transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;width:min(980px,90vw);max-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.kv-t.cc{left:50%;top:52%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);text-align:center;width:min(980px,90vw);max-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.kv-t.tc{left:50%;top:clamp(124px,15vh,156px);transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;width:min(1040px,90vw);max-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.kv-t:is(.bc,.cc,.tc) .at-ort,.kv-t:is(.bc,.cc,.tc) .knoepfe,.kv-t.mitte .knoepfe,.kv-t.mitte .at-ort{justify-content:center}
.kv-t.ml{left:var(--rand);top:54%;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.kv-t.mr{right:var(--rand);top:54%;transform:translateY(-50%);max-width:min(620px,44vw)}
.kv-t.tafel{background:var(--papier);color:var(--tinte);border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(28px,3vw,46px);box-shadow:var(--schatten-d);max-width:min(600px,46vw)}
.kv-t.tafel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:11px;border-radius:19px;border:1px solid rgba(191,152,46,.42);pointer-events:none}
.kv-t.tafel.cc,.kv-t.tafel.bc{width:min(640px,86vw)}
.kv-t.tafel.dunkel{background:rgba(43,52,45,.95);color:var(--hell)} .kv-t.tafel.dunkel::before{border-color:var(--gold-ll)}
.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .at-satz,.kv-t.dunkeltext .at-satz{color:var(--tinte2)}
.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .at-ort,.kv-t.dunkeltext .at-ort{color:var(--jade-t);text-shadow:none} .kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .at-ort i,.kv-t.dunkeltext .at-ort i{background:var(--jade-t)}
.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .titel .z:last-child>span{color:var(--jade-t)}
.kv-t .knoepfe{margin-top:30px} .kv-t.tafel .knoepfe{justify-content:center}
.kv-t.fluss{position:relative;max-width:none}
.kv-t .at-satz{max-width:52ch}
.kv-feld{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(30px,4vw,64px);min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.kv-g:not(.pad)>.kv-feld[style*="grid-area:1/"]{padding-top:130px}
.kv-feld.salbei{background:var(--salbei);color:var(--hell)} .kv-feld.tief{background:var(--tief);color:var(--hell)} .kv-feld.papier{background:var(--papier);color:var(--tinte)} .kv-feld.matcha{background:#5C7653;color:var(--hell)}
.kv-feld.karte{background:var(--papier);color:var(--tinte)}
.kv-feld.mitte{align-items:center;text-align:center} .kv-feld.mitte .kv-t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.kv-gross{font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:520;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 144;line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--hell)}
.kv-gross em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold-h)}
.hell .kv-gross,.kv-feld.papier .kv-gross{color:var(--tinte)} .hell .kv-gross em,.kv-feld.papier .kv-gross em{color:var(--jade-t)}
.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .kv-gross{color:var(--tinte)} .kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .kv-gross em{color:var(--jade-t)}
.kv-gross.klein{font-size:clamp(28px,2.8vw,46px);margin-top:20px;line-height:1.08}
.kv>.kv-gross{position:absolute;z-index:2}
.kv-gross.riesig{left:var(--rand);top:118px;font-size:clamp(90px,11vw,200px)}
.kv-gross.nummer{left:var(--rand);top:96px;font-size:clamp(160px,22vw,340px);color:var(--gold-h)}
.kv-gross.zeile{left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand);top:128px;font-size:clamp(54px,7vw,120px)}
.kv-gross.zahl{left:var(--rand);font-size:clamp(96px,11vw,180px)} .kv-gross.zahl small{display:block;font-family:var(--lauf);font-size:17px;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--hell2);margin-top:6px}
.kv-gross.zahl.oben{top:110px} .kv-gross.zahl.unten{top:calc(110px + clamp(96px,11vw,180px) + 46px)}
.kv-gross.oben-rechts{right:var(--rand);top:132px;font-size:clamp(80px,9vw,150px);text-align:right}
.kv-gross.adresse{left:var(--rand);top:122px;font-size:clamp(68px,9vw,160px);max-width:70vw}
.kv-gross.rechts-mitte{right:var(--rand);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);text-align:right;font-size:clamp(44px,5vw,86px);line-height:1.12}
.kv-gross.telefon{left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand);top:38%;font-size:clamp(54px,7.6vw,134px)}
.kv-zeilen{margin:22px 0 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(244,236,224,.18)}
.kv-zeilen div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(244,236,224,.12)}
.kv-zeilen dt{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 30;font-size:19px} .kv-zeilen dd{margin:0;opacity:.8;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.kv-zeilen dt b{font:400 13px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--gold-h);margin-right:10px}
.hell .kv-zeilen,.kv-feld.papier .kv-zeilen,.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .kv-zeilen{border-color:rgba(31,38,32,.16)}
.hell .kv-zeilen div,.kv-feld.papier .kv-zeilen div,.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .kv-zeilen div{border-color:rgba(31,38,32,.1)}
.hell .kv-zeilen dt b,.kv-feld.papier .kv-zeilen dt b,.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .kv-zeilen dt b{color:var(--jade-t)}
.kv-zeilen.deals dt{font-size:17px}
.kv-et{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;font:400 13px/1.4 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-h)}
.hell .kv-et,.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .kv-et{color:var(--jade-t)}
.kv-unterzeile{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:10px}
.kv-unterzeile span{padding:20px clamp(16px,2vw,30px) 26px;color:var(--hell2);font-size:15px}
.kv-unterzeile b{display:block;font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:500;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 40;font-size:26px;color:var(--hell)}
.kv-unterzeile.zahlen b{font-size:clamp(60px,6vw,96px);line-height:1}
.kv-liste{list-style:none}
.kv-liste li{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 36;font-size:22px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.12)}
.kv-liste.gross li{font-size:30px}
.kv>.kv-liste.riesig{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:var(--rand);top:126px;text-align:right}
.kv-liste.riesig li{font-size:clamp(40px,4.6vw,78px);line-height:1.04;border:0;padding:0}
.kv-liste.riesig li:nth-child(even){color:var(--jade-t)}
.kv-seiten{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:var(--rand);top:126px;bottom:56px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}
.kv-blatt{width:min(320px,22vw);background:var(--papier);color:var(--tinte);border-radius:22px;padding:28px;box-shadow:var(--schatten-d)}
.kv-blatt b{display:block;font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:500;font-size:24px;margin-bottom:12px}
.kv-blatt p{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:15px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.1)}
.kv-karten{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand);bottom:52px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
.kv-karte{background:var(--papier);color:var(--tinte);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--schatten-d);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.kv-karte .hk{height:clamp(160px,22vh,250px);transform:none!important}
.kv-karte b{font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:500;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 36;font-size:22px;padding:18px 22px 4px}
.kv-karte span{padding:0 22px 20px;color:var(--tinte2)}
.kv-karte.ohne{padding:12px 4px} .kv-karte.ohne small{padding:0 22px 18px;color:var(--tinte3);font-size:14px}
.kv-karte.ohne span{font-family:var(--titel);font-size:30px;color:var(--jade-t);padding-bottom:4px}
.kv-hoehen{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand);bottom:0;top:44%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px}
.kv-hoehen .hk{flex:1;height:100%;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0} .kv-hoehen .hk:nth-child(2){height:76%} .kv-hoehen .hk:nth-child(3){height:88%}
.kv-versetzt .hk{position:absolute;z-index:1;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:var(--schatten)}
.kv-versetzt .hk:first-child{left:var(--rand);top:122px;width:44%;height:54%}
.kv-versetzt .hk:last-child{left:28%;bottom:44px;width:32%;height:44%;z-index:2}
.kv-schritte{margin-top:26px;display:grid;gap:12px}
.kv-schritte p{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;font-size:19px}
.kv-schritte b{font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:500;font-size:54px;line-height:1;color:var(--gold-h)}
.kv-sprung{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px 22px;margin-top:24px}
.kv-sprung a{font-family:var(--titel);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"opsz" 30;font-size:20px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,38,32,.12)}
.kv-raumname{display:block;font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:500;font-size:28px;margin-bottom:6px} .kv-feld.tief span{color:var(--hell2)}
.kv-spalte.rechts{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:var(--rand);top:128px;width:min(380px,28vw);color:var(--hell)}
.kv-spalte .kv-liste li{border-color:rgba(244,236,224,.16)}
.kv-visite{position:relative;padding:28px 30px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--schatten);margin-bottom:34px;color:var(--tinte)}
.kv-visite b{display:block;font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:500;font-size:30px;margin-bottom:12px} .kv-visite p{color:var(--tinte2);margin-top:8px}
.kv-woche{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:var(--rand);right:var(--rand);bottom:56px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:10px}
.kv-woche div{background:var(--creme);border-radius:20px;padding:26px 14px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--schatten)}
.kv-woche b{display:block;font-family:var(--titel);font-weight:500;font-size:32px;margin-bottom:12px} .kv-woche span{font-size:15px;color:var(--tinte2)}
.kv-woche div.zu{background:var(--papier2);opacity:.75}
.kv .heute{margin:20px 0 0}
.kv-t.tafel:not(.dunkel) .heute{color:var(--tinte);background:rgba(31,38,32,.06)}

/* Wahlleiste (gemeinsam für Kopf und Fuss) */
.wahlleiste{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(var(--ecke) + 18px);z-index:80;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(31,38,32,.94);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gold-l),0 20px 40px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.7);color:var(--hell);transform:translate(-50%,0);transition:transform .7s var(--k),opacity .5s}
.wahlleiste.weg{transform:translate(-50%,160%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.wahlleiste button{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:0;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F8F1E6,#E3D7C5);color:var(--tief)} .wahlleiste button svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.wahlleiste .hw-t small{font:400 11px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--hell3);margin-right:2px}

@media (max-width:900px){
  .sk.kv{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;padding-top:88px}
  .kv-g,.kv>.hk.voll{position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;width:auto!important;margin:0!important}
  .kv>.hk.voll{height:56svh}
  .kv-g{height:auto!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;grid-template-rows:auto!important;padding:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important}
  .kv-g>*{grid-area:auto!important}
  .kv-g>.hk{aspect-ratio:1/1.08;height:auto!important;border-radius:0!important}
  .kv-g>.hk:only-child{grid-column:1/-1;aspect-ratio:4/3.4}
  .kv-g>.hk:nth-child(n+5){display:none}
  .kv-g>.kv-feld{grid-column:1/-1!important;padding:26px var(--rand)!important;order:-1}
  .kv-hof{display:none}
  .kv-t{position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;transform:none!important;max-width:none!important;width:auto!important;text-align:left!important;padding:26px var(--rand) 40px;margin:0!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;display:block!important}
  .kv-t::before{display:none}
  .kv-t .knoepfe{justify-content:flex-start!important} .kv-t .at-ort{flex-direction:row!important;justify-content:flex-start!important}
  .kv>.kv-gross{position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;transform:none!important;font-size:clamp(52px,15vw,96px)!important;padding:20px var(--rand) 0;max-width:none}
  .kv-unterzeile,.kv-seiten,.kv-karten,.kv-hoehen,.kv-woche,.kv-spalte,.kv>.kv-liste.riesig{position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;width:auto!important;margin:14px var(--rand)!important;text-align:left!important}
  .kv-unterzeile{grid-auto-flow:row;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .kv-seiten{flex-direction:column} .kv-blatt{width:auto}
  .kv-karten{grid-template-columns:1fr} .kv-hoehen{height:50svh} .kv-woche{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
  .kv-versetzt{position:relative;height:60svh;margin:0 var(--rand)} .kv-versetzt .hk:first-child{left:0;top:0;width:70%;height:62%} .kv-versetzt .hk:last-child{left:auto;right:0;bottom:0;width:58%;height:48%}
  .kv:not(.hell) .kv-t.dunkeltext{color:var(--hell)}
}

/* =========================================================  Fuss-Fassungen (fl) */
.fuss .fl-bild{position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin:0;background:var(--tief2) center/cover no-repeat;background-image:var(--lq)}
.fuss .fl-bild img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.fl-marke{display:block;height:58px;color:#F4ECE0} .fl-marke svg{height:100%;width:auto;display:block}

.fl-sp p,.fl-sp a{color:var(--hell2)} .fl-sp p{line-height:1.7} .fl-sp p+p{margin-top:12px} .fl-sp .fl-marke{margin-bottom:16px}

.fl-recht{display:flex;gap:22px;justify-content:center;margin-top:16px;font-size:14px} .fl-recht a{color:var(--hell3)}
.fuss .titel em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold-h)}
